name: Walker Tienkung · Embodied Intelligence
summary: UBTECH Walker Tienkung · Embodied Intelligence (product model TK2301): the top model of UBTECH's Walker Tienkung series of full-size, fully electric humanoid running robots (developed jointly with the Beijing Humanoid Robotics Innovation Center). Per UBTECH's user manual: 1730 ± 10 mm, 75 kg net, 42 integrated joints (head 3, arms 7 × 2, hands 6 × 2, waist 1, legs 6 × 2), dexterous hands as standard, high-precision 6-DoF force sensing, three RGB-D cameras, a voice module, two NVIDIA Orin AGX 64 development units (275 TOPS each) plus an Intel i7-1355U motion-control unit, 30 Ah + 3 Ah / 48 V dual battery with more than 3.5 h endurance. Intended by UBTECH for scientific research and education. A separate model from the Walker Tienkung · Voice & Vision (TK2201) and the base Walker Tienkung (TK2101), and from the Walker S1/S2 industrial line.
